items.title: What China’s Critical Minerals Pause Means For Metals And Mining Funds
items.summary: One of the sharpest contrasts here is that VAW only has about 29% in metals and mining businesses, while GDX and GDXJ are almost entirely tied to miners. That split matters more now that China has halted a planned ban on critical minerals exports to the US, which eases supply limits on materials that feed into semiconductors, batteries and defence equipment.
